task.title: A restaurant I like

expected_response.cognitive_demand: Describe people, places, objects, routines; State and support a personal opinion

criteria.name: Task fulfilment
criteria.description: How fully and appropriately the response does what the task asks: required points, purpose, audience and, where relevant, position.
criteria.successful_performance: Covers all required points briefly and keeps to the topic; purpose of the message or text is clear. Required points: where it is; what you ate and drank; what the service and prices are like; say if you recommend it
criteria.weak_performance: Several required points missing, or the purpose of the text is unclear.
criteria.expected_evidence: Which required points are present; how each is supported; whether purpose, audience and position are clear. Check each required point: where it is; what you ate and drank; what the service and prices are like; say if you recommend it.
common_error_patterns: missing greeting or ending in a message
criteria.evaluation_limitations: Content knowledge is not assessed; do not penalise factual inaccuracy unless the task asks for accuracy to a supplied source.

criteria.name: Coherence and cohesion
criteria.description: How logically the ideas connect and how clearly linking devices and reference express those connections.
criteria.successful_performance: Ideas follow a clear order; common linkers (and, but, because, so, then) are used mostly correctly.
criteria.weak_performance: Ideas listed without links; frequent repetition of 'and'.
criteria.expected_evidence: Order of ideas; variety and accuracy of linkers; clarity of pronoun reference; paragraph logic.
criteria.evaluation_limitations: A text can be cohesive and still weak on content; keep this criterion separate from task fulfilment.

criteria.name: Lexical resource
criteria.description: Range, precision and appropriateness of vocabulary, including collocation and word formation.
criteria.successful_performance: Uses everyday vocabulary suited to the topic with some variety; errors rarely block meaning.
criteria.weak_performance: Same words repeated; frequent wrong word choice or spelling affects meaning.
criteria.expected_evidence: Range of topic words; repetition; collocation; word formation; spelling. Expected vocabulary demands: food and drink; restaurant words; adjectives of opinion.
criteria.evaluation_limitations: Do not reward unusual words that are used incorrectly; do not penalise a plain word that is correct and appropriate.

l1_transfer_hypotheses.caution: These are hypotheses about common patterns; they are NOT to be reported as a learner weakness from a single instance.

criteria.name: Grammatical range and accuracy
criteria.description: Range of structures used and the accuracy with which they are controlled, including punctuation that affects clarity.
criteria.successful_performance: Simple sentences and some past or future forms are correct; some complex sentences attempted with errors that rarely block meaning.
criteria.weak_performance: Frequent errors in tense and agreement; very few complex sentences.
criteria.expected_evidence: Types of structures; proportion of error-free sentences; kinds of errors; whether errors are systematic. Structures invited by the task: past_simple, comparatives_superlatives.
criteria.evaluation_limitations: Judge by the structures the learner chooses and controls; do not penalise absence of structures the task does not invite.

l1_transfer_hypotheses.caution: These are hypotheses about common patterns; they are NOT to be reported as a learner weakness from a single instance.

criteria.name: Register and appropriateness
criteria.description: Whether tone, formality, conventions of text type and politeness suit the audience and purpose.
criteria.successful_performance: Tone is polite or friendly as the task requires; uses basic message conventions. Audience: readers of a website. Register: neutral, friendly
criteria.weak_performance: Too informal in a polite message or too stiff in a friendly one.
criteria.expected_evidence: Greeting/closing; politeness markers; formality of vocabulary and structures; conventions.
criteria.evaluation_limitations: Only scored where the task defines an audience/register; otherwise treat as not applicable.

not_assessed_by_design.name: Organisation and development of ideas
not_assessed_by_design.reason: Not required by this task type at this level, so it must not be used to reduce the score.

policy.observed_error_vs_weakness: A diagnostic category is an OBSERVED error pattern when at least one instance is found in a response. It may be reported as an INFERRED learning weakness only after >= 3 instances in one response set of >= 100 words (or >= 2 responses) and when the error is not explained by task demands (for example a tense the task did not invite).

diagnostics.observed_vs_inferred: An error is OBSERVED when an instance appears in the response. It may be recorded as an INFERRED weakness only under the policy in diagnostics.policy (repeated instances, enough text, and not explained by task demands).
